name: Drana
description: Drana is the last surviving bloodchief of the Kalastria vampire family on Zendikar and a leader of its vampires.

timeline.summary: Drana surveys her refugees fleeing the Eldrazi host across Guul Draz.
timeline.quote: There in the midst of the host was the enormous Eldrazi sire

citation.text: "Memories of Blood" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Sep 2015.

timeline.summary: A hundred kor on kitesails arrive from Tazeem, and Drana decides to welcome them.
timeline.quote: "Welcome. They come to join us at the end of the world. We will be accommodating."

citation.text: "Memories of Blood" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Sep 2015.

timeline.summary: Enkindi, sent by Gideon, invites Drana's army to join Gideon's stand at Sea Gate.
timeline.quote: "Win. We can win. Many of you are still strong. We know what you can do in battle. Join us."

citation.text: "Memories of Blood" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Sep 2015.

timeline.summary: Drana shows Enkindi the Orphans' Brigade of children and proposes he fight with her first before she goes to Sea Gate.
timeline.quote: I'll leave with you to fight with Gideon at Sea Gate, if you and your warriors fight with me first.

citation.text: "Memories of Blood" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Sep 2015.

timeline.summary: The vampires, mortals and kor battle the three Eldrazi hosts, with the sire as the key target.
timeline.quote: Mortal and vampire alike met the initial onslaught with a fierce savagery.

citation.text: "Memories of Blood" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Sep 2015.

timeline.summary: Drana orders the Orphans' Brigade toward the sire as bait; Enkindi calls her a monster but leads his kor at the sire.
timeline.quote: The children will serve as necessary bait to lure the sire where we need it to be.

citation.text: "Memories of Blood" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Sep 2015.

timeline.summary: Drana bores into the sire's heart and drinks its energy, recovering memories of her origin as a creature of Ulamog.
timeline.quote: I was no longer an extension of it, of the consuming force named Ulamog.

citation.text: "Memories of Blood" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Sep 2015.

timeline.summary: The Eldrazi energy overwhelms Drana, but she reasserts herself with 'I serve no one' and consumes the energy.
timeline.quote: I serve no one! I will be free!

citation.text: "Memories of Blood" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Sep 2015.

timeline.summary: Drana releases the Eldrazi energy as a magenta sun that heals her army and destroys the Eldrazi, then collapses.
timeline.quote: I belong to no one . . . but they belong to me.

citation.text: "Memories of Blood" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Sep 2015.

timeline.summary: Drana orders her survivors to cross to Tazeem to Sea Gate, having learned the Eldrazi have somewhere to go back to.
timeline.quote: "Make preparations to cross to Tazeem. We are going to Sea Gate."

citation.text: "Memories of Blood" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Sep 2015.

timeline.summary: Drana declares she will not live as a slave and calls others to fight.
timeline.quote: I will not live as a slave. If you would be free, then fight alongside me.

citation.text: Drana, Liberator of Malakir (Battle for Zendikar, 2015), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Tazri joins Gideon, Drana and Munda to retake Sea Gate; a failure kills many Zendikari but Sea Gate is reclaimed after training.
timeline.quote: Despite her worries, Sea Gate was reclaimed after intensive training

citation.text: "Tazri", section "The Battle for Zendikar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tazri meets Nissa and Kiora and urges evacuation while Gideon, Drana and Kiora plan to fight the titan; Jace proposes trapping Ulamog with the hedron network.
timeline.quote: saying Ulamog could be trapped using an aligned hedron network.

citation.text: "Tazri", section "The Battle for Zendikar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Saved by her halo, Tazri regroups with Noyan Dar, Drana and Munda and takes command, leading to Chandra's arrival.
timeline.quote: inspired by the angel she had killed so long ago, took command.

citation.text: "Tazri", section "The Battle for Zendikar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Zendikari vampires fall into civil war as the Eldrazi escape; the Ghet seize holdings and Drana retakes Malakir before being driven out.
timeline.quote: Drana struck back, retaking control of Malakir and driving Kalitas and his traitors away from the city.

citation.text: "Vampire", section "Civil War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: At dusk the army retreats in a planned maneuver and Drana's vampires take the front ranks, fighting through the night.
timeline.quote: But the maneuver went off without incident.

citation.text: "The Liberation of Sea Gate" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Oct 2015.

timeline.summary: Kiora climbs the lighthouse and enters Gideon's meeting of advisors uninvited.
timeline.quote: Her lack of invitation was clearly an oversight. She marched in.

citation.text: "Hedron Alignment" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Nov 2015.

timeline.summary: Tazri argues for evacuation while Drana, Nissa and Kiora argue for an assault.
timeline.quote: An assault is the only reason I'm here,

citation.text: "Hedron Alignment" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Nov 2015.

timeline.summary: Kiora volunteers to lead the offensive and demonstrates the bident by sending a wave through the window.
timeline.quote: Only the most powerful artifact on all of Zendikar

citation.text: "Hedron Alignment" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Nov 2015.

timeline.summary: Gideon, after a moment alone, orders that they will not evacuate but stay, fight and kill the titan.
timeline.quote: We do not evacuate. We stay and we fight. And we kill the titan.

citation.text: "Hedron Alignment" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Nov 2015.

timeline.summary: Gideon orders the army to build the trap and assigns commanders to patrols, telling them to keep Kiora from interfering.
timeline.quote: We will build the trap, and once we have secured our target, we will launch our offensive as planned.

citation.text: "Hedron Alignment" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Nov 2015.

timeline.summary: Gideon gathers Drana, Noyan Dar, Tazri, Nissa and Kiora's forces and retakes Sea Gate from the Eldrazi.
timeline.quote: Together, their combined forces managed to wrest Sea Gate away from the Eldrazi invaders.

citation.text: "Battle for Zendikar Story Summary" by Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Dec 2015.

timeline.summary: Drana rescues Noyan Dar in mid-air, and Drana's and Munda's troops turn the tide briefly.
timeline.quote: The arrival of Drana's and Munda's troops had temporarily turned the tide of battle.

citation.work: The Blight We Were Born For
citation.text: "The Blight We Were Born For" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jan 2016.

timeline.summary: Tazri persuades Drana to follow her as general and to feed energy to Noyan Dar.
timeline.quote: As you command, General Tazri,

citation.work: The Blight We Were Born For
citation.text: "The Blight We Were Born For" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jan 2016.

timeline.summary: General Tazri is saved by her halo and takes command of the regrouped forces.
timeline.quote: General Tazri was saved by the protection of her halo.

citation.text: "Zendikar (plane)", section "Oath of the Gatewatch". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Survivors gather in the ash with no celebration, and Kiora leaves with the bident.
timeline.quote: And she didn't stop walking for a long time.

citation.text: "Zendikar's Last Stand" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Feb 2016.

timeline.summary: Drana, the last bloodchief, leads vampires to new strength in unity.
timeline.quote: Under Drana's leadership, vampires are finding new strength in unity.

citation.text: Nighthawk Scavenger (Zendikar Rising, 2020), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Kalitas seizes holdings outside Malakir and threatens to make vampires Eldrazi thralls; Drana drives him out and retakes Malakir.
timeline.quote: She drove Kalitas and his traitors away from the city, retaking control of Malakir.

citation.text: "Drana", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Drana and her people evacuate Malakir before the Eldrazi arrive and she joins Gideon Jura's troops.
timeline.quote: she decided to join forces with the troops of Gideon Jura on Tazeem

citation.text: "Drana", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Drana begrudgingly lets Tazri take command and survives Zendikar's Last Stand.
timeline.quote: She survived Zendikar's Last Stand with Ulamog and Kozilek

citation.text: "Drana", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Drana and Linvala fight side by side in the skies and grow to respect one another.
timeline.quote: eventually an appreciation for each other’s unique strengths and combat prowess

citation.text: "Drana", section "Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gideon sends Enkindi and his kitesailers to Guul Draz, where he meets Drana and tries to recruit her.
timeline.quote: Gideon sent Enkindi and his kitesailers to Guul Draz to look for any survivors

citation.text: "Enkindi", section "Battle for Zendikar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Enkindi is horrified to see children among Drana's force, but Drana is unapologetic.
timeline.quote: Drana did not offer any apologies, calling them little warriors

citation.text: "Enkindi", section "Battle for Zendikar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Enkindi's sacrifice spares Melindra and other children, and Drana's survivors reach Gideon at Sea Gate.
timeline.quote: his sacrifice did help spare the lives of Melindra and many of the other warrior children

citation.text: "Enkindi", section "Battle for Zendikar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Linvala and Drana fight in the same skies and come to respect each other.
timeline.quote: bloodchief magic and angelic powers complemented each other surprisingly well

citation.text: "Linvala", section "Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Drana escapes the slaughter and returns with free survivors to reclaim Malakir and turn it into a fortress.
timeline.quote: Together they reclaimed Malakir

citation.text: "Malakir", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After the Eldrazi's defeat only Drana is said to survive among the bloodchiefs, so Rayami must be dead.
timeline.quote: Drana was said to be the only surviving bloodchief, so Rayami must now be dead.

citation.text: "Rayami", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

relations.quote: all, vampire and mortal alike, bowed with her passing.

citation.text: "Memories of Blood" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Sep 2015.

relations.note: One of her personal overseers for millennia.
relations.quote: Kan had been one of her personal overseers for millennia.

citation.text: "Memories of Blood" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Sep 2015.

citation.text: "Memories of Blood" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Sep 2015.

relations.note: She was made in the shadow of her makers and recalls being its extension.
relations.quote: I was no longer an extension of it, of the consuming force named Ulamog.

citation.text: "Memories of Blood" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Sep 2015.

relations.note: Her people are being driven out by them.
relations.quote: she and her remaining people were driven from the city by ever-growing hordes of Eldrazi.

citation.text: "Memories of Blood" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Sep 2015.

relations.note: Drana's vampires say never again to servitude under the Eldrazi.
relations.quote: Kalitas may have returned to mindless servitude beneath the Eldrazi, but we say never again.

citation.text: Kalastria Nightwatch (Battle for Zendikar, 2015), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

relations.note: Drana is the bloodchief of the vampire troops.

citation.text: "The Liberation of Sea Gate" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Oct 2015.
